transcript_only_text:
When I'm forced to make a decision
between two things, I prefer to choose the one that's the more epic story. I've
thought about that frame a lot and it's still continued to win out. Because
either you have an epic story of failure or you have an epic story of success,
but no 85-year-olds are regretting their epic stories. They are regretting the
stories they never told.
